facts.fact: IAB's 2026 Outlook Study, released January 28, 2026, forecasts US connected TV ad spend growing 13.8% in 2026.
facts.quote: IAB’s 2026 Outlook Study, released January 28, 2026, forecasts US connected TV (CTV) ad spend growing 13.8% in 2026, up from 11.4% growth in 2025.

facts.fact: IAB reported US CTV ad spend grew 11.4% in 2025.
facts.quote: up from 11.4% growth in 2025

facts.fact: IAB projects US digital video ad spend, which includes CTV, to pass $80 billion in 2026.
facts.quote: For the wider category, IAB projects US digital video ad spend, which includes CTV, to pass $80 billion in 2026.

facts.fact: IAB's digital video forecast puts US spend above $80 billion in 2026, growing 11% year over year.
facts.quote: IAB’s digital video forecast puts US spend above $80 billion in 2026, growing 11% year over year.

facts.fact: IAB's 2026 Outlook Study built its forecast on responses from more than 200 brand and agency buyers.
facts.quote: IAB built its 2026 Outlook Study on responses from more than 200 brand and agency buyers

facts.fact: IAB's January 2026 outlook forecast 9.5% growth in total US ad spend for 2026.
facts.quote: It forecast 9.5% growth in total US ad spend for 2026.

facts.fact: IAB's January 2026 outlook forecast social media ad spend growth of 14.6% and linear TV decline of 1.7% in 2026.
facts.quote: By channel, IAB expected CTV to grow 13.8% and social media 14.6%. It also expected linear TV to decline 1.7%
